operation.name: CreateGBVMain_ELRP
UpdateGBVMain_ELRP
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVMainID FROM [GBVMain_ELRP] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND GBVMainID = @GBVMainID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
UPDATE [GBVMain_ELRP] SET [StateID] = @StateID ,[CountyID] = @CountyID ,[PayamID] = @PayamID ,[BomaID] = @BomaID ,[DateOfIncident] = @DateOfIncident ,[ContactFocalPointPersonName] = @ContactFocalPointPersonName ,[VerbalConsentGranted] = @VerbalConsentGranted ,[ConsentSigned] = @ConsentSigned ,[ConsentSignedID] = @ConsentSignedID ,[DescriptionOfTheIncident] = @DescriptionOfTheIncident ,[DescriptionOfTheIncidentID] = @DescriptionOfTheIncidentID ,[IncidentReportedBy] = @IncidentReportedBy ,[IncidentReportedByOther] = @IncidentReportedByOther ,[ReportingChannel] = @ReportingChannel ,[ReportingChannelOther] = @ReportingChannelOther ,[ContactNumber] = @ContactNumber ,[Gender] = @Gender ,[AgeOfSurvivor] = @AgeOfSurvivor ,[SSSNPBeneficiary] = @SSSNPBeneficiary ,[SuspectAssociatedWithProject] = @SuspectAssociatedWithProject ,[SuspectAssosiatedWithProjectNotes] = @SuspectAssosiatedWithProjectNotes ,[SuspectKnown] = @SuspectKnown ,[SuspectKnownDetail] = @SuspectKnownDetail ,[ReferralServicesRecommended] = @ReferralServicesRecommended ,[LastModificationTimestamp] = @LastModificationTimestamp ,[LastModificationUserID] = @LastModificationUserID ,[StatusAfterReferral] = @StatusAfterReferral ,[RecommendedDetails] = @RecommendedDetails
WHERE Deleted = 0 and GBVMainID = @GBVMainID SET @ReturnValue = 1
END

operation.name: GetGBVMain_ELRP
operation.query:
SELECT [GBVMainID] ,[Date] ,[SerialNumber] ,[StateID] ,[CountyID] ,[PayamID] ,[BomaID] ,[Status] ,[DateOfIncident] ,[ContactFocalPointPersonName] ,[VerbalConsentGranted] ,[ConsentSigned] ,[ConsentSignedID] ,[DescriptionOfTheIncident] ,[DescriptionOfTheIncidentID] ,[IncidentReportedBy] ,[IncidentReportedByOther] ,[ReportingChannel] ,[ReportingChannelOther] ,[ContactNumber] ,[Gender] ,[AgeOfSurvivor] ,[SSSNPBeneficiary] ,[SuspectAssociatedWithProject] ,[SuspectAssosiatedWithProjectNotes] ,[SuspectKnown] ,[SuspectKnownDetail] ,[ReferralServicesRecommended] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[StatusAfterReferral] ,[RecommendedDetails] FROM [GBVMain_ELRP]
WHERE Deleted =0 AND GBVMainID = @GBVMainID

operation.name: DeleteGBVMain_ELRP
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVMainID FROM [GBVMain_ELRP] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND GBVMainID = @GBVMainID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
UPDATE [GBVMain_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE GBVMainID = @GBVMainID
SET @ReturnValue = 1
END

operation.name: UpdateGBVStatus_ELRP
operation.query: UPDATE [GBVMain_ELRP] SET [Status] = @Status ,[StatusLastModificationDate] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationTimestamp] = getdate() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @userID WHERE GBVMainID = @GBVMainID and Deleted = 0 set @ReturnValue = 1

operation.name: GetGBVMainIDByDetailID_ELRP
operation.query:
set @ReturnValue = (SELECT top 1 m.GBVMainID
FROM [GBVMain_ELRP] as M left join GBVDetails as d on (d.GBVMainID = m.GBVMainID and d.Deleted = 0) where d.Deleted = 0 and d.GBVDetailID = @GBVDetailID)
